reviewAdvisory: The 9 million unit increase is derived from an assumed H1 2025 baseline that the figures do not supply; only the 27 percent growth rate is given, so the absolute delta is invented arithmetic.
The report contains no price, cost or rate figure, so the claim that tracking is now cheaper or bundled is an inference presented as fact with no sourced baseline.
The figures describe terminal counts by sector, not which forwarders, ports or platforms use Beidou, so 'almost certainly' and 'comes from a Beidou terminal' are unsupported.
No figure in the directive compares Beidou with GPS cost or coverage, so the claim that GPS adds cost for no benefit is unsupported.
The 9 million figure is not in the supplied figure records and cannot be derived without an H1 2025 baseline the directive does not contain.
The body states 'The numbers say yes' and 'it is the baseline' as settled fact, while the confidence section admits the default claim is only inferred, so the two sections contradict each other.
